Best known for his operas, he was a crucial figure in the development of German Romantische Oper (German Romantic opera).[1]. Throughout his youth, his father, Franz Anton, relentlessly moved the family between Hamburg, Salzburg, Freiberg, Augsburg and Vienna. Thought 4: Carl Maria von Weber is described as a "crucial figure in the development of German Romantische Oper (German Romantic opera)". He was born in 1786 and died in 1826. Heinrich Marschner was born in 1795 and died in 1861. Marschner's career (1795-1861) clearly falls after Weber's (1786-1826).
